276557591.description:
Natural Selenite Crystal
Large Raw Log / Wand Specimen
Translucent White, Approximately 12 Pounds
Substantial raw selenite crystal specimen featuring a classic fibrous habit and characteristic satiny luster, often referred to as "satin spar." This large log format showcases the natural vertical striations of the mineral, making it a prominent display piece for mineral collectors or interior decor. Selenite is a variety of the mineral gypsum, prized for its pearly luminescence and unique light-reflecting properties.
Impressive 12-pound weight providing significant physical presence
Translucent white coloration with natural amber-toned matrix inclusions visible at the base
Raw, unpolished surfaces highlighting the natural crystalline structure and parallel striations
Substantial length of approximately 22 inches, suitable for floor display or larger shelving
Condition:
Natural raw state with characteristic fibrous texture. Minor shedding or flaking of small crystalline shards is inherent to the mineral's structure and may occur during handling. Surface shows natural cleavage planes and raw termination points. The base retains original mineral matrix attachments.
